label: Grief
subhead: Poses that open the chest and ribs, where held breath tends to gather.

label: Fear
subhead: Poses working the low back, kidneys, and inner legs — the body's deepest reserves.

label: Frustration
subhead: Side-body and outer-hip work, along the channels associated with stalled momentum.

label: Vulnerability
subhead: Front-body opening. Exposing the soft surfaces is the whole of the shape.

label: Control
subhead: Poses that ask the grip to soften rather than the range to increase.

label: Courage
subhead: Heart-opening shapes that widen the chest without bracing it.

label: Surrender
subhead: Supported, long-held shapes where the work is in stopping.

label: Groundedness
subhead: Weight low and wide, with the belly and legs taking the load.

label: Anger
subhead: Liver-channel work through the inner thigh and side waist.

label: Openness
subhead: Shapes that widen across the collarbones and the front of the shoulders.

label: Letting go
subhead: Passive spinal work along the back line, where holding is habitual.

label: Trust
subhead: Shapes that need support to enter, and settle once it is there.

label: Integration
subhead: Neutral, quieting shapes for the space after stronger work.
